reviews.text: THANK YOU so much for making my dog feel and look fabulous. We’ve been coming here for the past year and you all have shown my dog nothing but love and patience. ❤️. Best salon in Houston
Hi Karina, thank you so much for your 5-star review! We appreciate your support and look forward to seeing you and your pup again soon at The Dog House Pet Salon - Memorial Park. 🐾 …

We love the Dog House Pet Salon. Our girl is happy from all the fun she has had when she is there. We couldn't be happier with the care and love they show her. She loves seeing her Uncle Jeff
Supremely kind and caring staff. The only place that brushes out my huskies fully!
I like the new text tracking & notifications for grooming
That take excellent care of your pet! This is one of the best groomers!
I love this place! My fur baby literally races in every time we come. Excellent grooming and boarding

I just picked my poodle up from
his first groom and immediately had to write a review! We just moved to Houston from Michigan and while searching for groomers I realized we lived right next door to The Dog House Pet Salon! I am pretty particular about where my dog gets groomed because he’s a poodle and I like to make sure groomers know about breed standard cuts for poodles as it does make a difference even with little things like the top knot shape etc.  Donna blew his summer cut I have for him right now out of the park!!
The woman at the front desk was so helpful, kind and explained things so thoroughly. They have a new system where I can see where my dog is in the grooming process which is awesome and something I have not had at any other grooming spot he has gone!  The pricing is also extremely reasonable for a full large poodle groom and they gave me a discount for his first groom with them! Would 100% recommend it here!
I love bringing my two poms here, they always look so cute once they have been groomed! Absolutely LOVE the new app! Super convenient and easy to use!

We absolutely LOVE The Dog House Pet Salon. Their service their people…. Melissa, Courtney, Kameron, Francy… they are all the best. Our babies are always happy to go see them. The grooming is the best!!!

My boy is the happiest in this daycare! All the staff is amazing and very professional, you can tell they love our furry babies and I leave to work happy and in peace knowing that my boy is in good hands ❤️🐾  Thanks for all the amazing job you guys do ✨ …
These guys are awesome…take our golden doodle and golden retriever and both come out looking great…highly recommend!

Thank you, Angel, for the 5-star review! We’re glad to hear you found our pricing reasonable and had a great experience at our Memorial Park location. We appreciate your support and look forward to seeing you and your pup again soon! 🐾 …

We just love the Dog House Pet Salon! From the friendly staff at the front desk when you walk in, how amazing my dog looks and smells after his oatmeal bath and how much fun he has playing with the other pups!!! Thank you DHPS!!! 🐶 …

Thank you, Octavian, for the 5-star review! We truly appreciate you choosing our Memorial Park location and are glad you had a great experience with us. We look forward to seeing you and your pup again soon! 🐾 …

I’ve brought my dog here about three times now, and I always like to start by saying I know she’s not the easiest. She’s a schnauzer with a big voice for her size, so I usually give her medication before her grooming appointments.

That said, they’ve done an excellent job every single time. What really stands out is how well they handle her nails. She’s very particular and doesn’t cooperate easily, and in the past I’ve picked her up from other groomers with nails still too long. Here, they’ve consistently managed to get them done properly, which I really appreciate.

Also, the front desk staff is incredibly kind. When I asked how my dog did, she mentioned she didn’t even hear her during the grooming, which says a lot but she didn’t see her on the grooming table. Then, after I left, she actually called me with feedback, which I loved since I always want to make sure her medication dose is appropriate.

Overall, it’s been an excellent experience so far.

We are so glad we found this salon, and we will never go anywhere else. I was surprised I saw him on the photos!!! y’all can see they treat my boy with such care and get his cut just right every time!

We love the Dog House Pet Salon. The entire staff is incredibly friendly and clearly cares about dogs. They treat my dog as their own. My pup gets excited when we arrive and comes happy and exhausted. The facility is clean and well managed. High recommend!
We found our new home for getting our dogs groomed. The staff is very friendly and our dogs look great every time!

This is absolutely the best place to bring your pet. They love my mini hellion, I mean Goldendoodle, Ollie, lol and they treat him as if he is their own. He adores attending daycare and playing with the other puppies. They have several specials, including a loyalty card that gets you money off of a grooming! The pricing is affordable, as well. I highly recommend:)

We took our sweet, nervous Flash here for the first time today.  The Dog House was recommended by a friend.  It was his first ever grooming appointment as he’s short haired and we usually have his toenails clipped at the vet.  I dropped him off at 8:00 and he was ready by 9:30.  His toenails look great and he seemed to be happy, not at all upset by the process.  The front desk staff was warm and helpful.  It was a great experience!

Filled out an appointment request, never heard back, despite guarantee of same-day response if submitting before 5pm. Called to confirm and they said they won't accept my email address because it's not a normal domain. Tried another domain that I own, and they still refused it. Told me to go somewhere else for services.

1. Why do I need an account at all? You're selling a service that I'm trying to buy. That should be the end of the discussion.
2. You lost out on $120 and repeat business because you want a more personal email address you can spam with marketing slop? What kind of business is that?

Don't go here. They won't perform the service they advertise unless you give them an email they can spam.

I have not take my pet to the pet salon, however I was at the McDonalds across the street and saw this employee spraying water on the dogs to keep the dogs in line. I found it kinds of cruel. I don’t think I will be going to this place or recommend anyone to take there pets there either.

My experience here was fantastic! My dog, who usually hesitates to leave our side, was so happy that she didn’t even want to leave. The staff was incredibly kind and attentive to her, ensuring that I was satisfied with everything before proceeding to the checkout. Pricing is very affordable! They even waited for me because I was stuck in traffic and a bit late picking her up! Overall, it was a wonderful experience, and I’ll definitely be returning. :)
They take great care of my pets.

Thank you very much for the wonderful 5-star rating, Gregg! We're delighted that you had such a positive experience at The Dog House Pet Salon. It’s our priority to make every visit enjoyable and seamless, and we’re grateful for your support. We look forward to welcoming you back for more tail-wagging adventures!

If you asked me yesterday it would have been 5 stars. And there should be a no star option. I've been going to Dog House Pet Salon on Washington for a year or more with no problem. For a routine groom for my 15 year old shih tzu they cut him not once, but TWICE to the point both needed sutures. The vet bill was over $1000 which they covered of course. My poor dog came home with stitches in two areas, an e-collar, drugged from sedation, intubation and only half groomed because they couldn't finish. There's a whole story to this which I'll save you from. Here's the kicker why I WILL NOT return to this location or company. Francy Quevedo, master groomer came out and told me how thin my 15 year old dogs skin is. (Yes, I know) And that it's me that asks for his hair to be cut short. Then she begins to tell me clipper sizes by number that she uses to meet my request and telling me he was cut because I asked for short hair and his skin is too thin for those shorter hair clippers. I don't know what clippers sizes are safe or the right ones to use, should I? I'm not the groomer. Yes I asked for short hair, but reasonably short hair. See Photo of the normal cut he usually gets, attached and his injuries received this time. I never asked for a skin close shave. Not once. And never at the risk of my dog being cut! If she's the master groomer, wouldn't she know to NOT use a certain size clipper on a senior dog with thin skin? Wouldn't she be the one to make the ultimate decision for his safety to give him the best care without injury and a suitable cut? I don't know clipper sizes, I'm not a groomer. That's WHY I TAKE HIM TO THE GROOMER for their expertise. If this is the level of care in services today then should I become an expert in clipper sizes or brake pads for my car? Or my own dental care? Electrical? Why do we have MASTER anything if they can't make the decision on which clipper to use for the safety of the dog to not cause injury but then tell me it's my fault since I asked for short hair on my dog? To be fair, Francy said one of the other certified groomers did his groom. But Where is the accountability for the master groomer to just say "We used the wrong clipper on your dog and this happened. I'm so sorry". I would have appreciated that accountability and thanked them for ensuring his proper medical attention. I'm a reasonable person. Mistakes happen. Sure she said she was sorry but no....not one time did she take any responsibility for the Salon and their mistake that sent my dog to the vet for sedation and intubation and oxygen needed because of his age. He's gotten to a healthy 15 years on his own and I don't need someone else's poor decisions to send him to the vet for unnecessary procedures. AND THEN BLAME ME FOR IT. It was her blatant lack of accountability and projecting the blame on to me, the customer that I will not return. Clearly I can't trust their judgement for the safety of my dog ever again if she's going to blame clipper size on me. That's where they lost me. Cameron....my friend, you deserve 5 stars all around. You've been amazing to work with there and I appreciate your kindness. And Melissa was really great as well during this situation caring for Milo. Thank you, Cameron & Melissa. But still not returning.
great service and the perfects cuts
Great, we took our dogs out so we could enjoy the city a bit without worrying about putting them in danger! 10/10

What a beautiful place! 🐾
This spot isn’t just for baths it’s a full-on sanctuary for pups. From the grooming area to the daycare, everything is spotless, cozy, and filled with love.

The team is amazing with the dogs you can tell they genuinely care. I take my pup here for baths and daycare, and he always leaves happy (and smelling delicious!).

But what makes this place extra special is that they also help with rescues. Thanks to them, I’m in the process of adopting my new baby, and I couldn’t be more excited or grateful.
They’re not just a dog spa they’re part of the family. 💛🐶

A Pawsitively Wonderful Experience for Atlas

I took my dog Atlas for his very first grooming appointment here, and I couldn't be happier with how everything went. From the moment we walked in, the staff were warm, gentle, and truly professional. It was clear they love what they do--and more importantly, that they love dogs.

Atlas can be a little high-strung, so I specifically chose this place because of the great reviews about their experience with anxious pups. I'm so glad I did! He was calm and at ease, which is not always the case at new places. He seemed to feel safe and comfortable, and even looked like he was enjoying the attention.

When I picked him up, he looked and smelled amazing--his coat was soft and clean, and his nails were perfectly filed down. I could tell he was well taken care of, and that means everything to me.

Thank you for treating my sweet Atlas with such kindness. We'll absolutely be coming back for more doggie pampering!
Amazing staff

Thank you so much for your five-star rating! Your support means the world to us, and we're grateful for the opportunity to care for your pet. Looking forward to seeing you and your furry pal again soon!
Not a a better place in Houston for pet services.  They treat your cat like it’s family

We have been going to another location and we switched to this location.  To our delightful surprise,  Ms Donna is at this location and she is definitely our most favorite.  Bravo 👏 Team Awesome.  Our fur babies came back flawless. …
great staff, amazing place

We love Dog House Pet Salon so much and more importantly, our little sheepadoodle Olivey loves it! Francie, the manager of the Memorial Park location, is so kind and gentle with our little fur baby and gives her the most picture perfect Teddy Bear cut you’ve ever seen. We know when we drop her off she is in good hands and they will take care of her and pamper her the entire time. We can’t say enough about Francie, Alex, Kameron, Donna and everyone at Dog House Pet Salon!

We searched high and low for the right Groomer for our sweet Roxie, who is an Australian Labradoodle.  We hit the jackpot with Francie after searching for two years!!!Roxie's always so happy when she comes home and looks beautiful. We trust Francie with Roxie and no one else!!  Francie is kind, considerate, consistent, and a hard worker who always has a smile on her face and you can tell she loves what she does! Roxie always smells great and looks so beautiful. 💗

The Dog House Pet Salon is amazing! Francy is friendly, professional, and truly cares about the pets they groom. My dog always comes back looking great, smelling fresh, and happy. They handle everything with care and make sure the experience is as stress-free as possible. I highly recommend them to anyone looking for top-quality grooming services!

We have been taking our cockapoo Eloise to The Dog House for years. They have always been so easy to deal with and their service and grooming is excellent. They are very strict about dogs having the proper vaccinations so we know she is in a safe environment. The staff there are so friendly and know us by name. We love Cameron!

I’ve been taking my dogs here for both grooming and boarding for the last 5 years. Kameron is absolutely delightful! He has always been very accommodating with my work travel. He greets you with a welcoming smile despite how busy they are with customers or the phones ringing. He is so polite and has such a positive demeanor. Boarding is very reasonable and having doggie daycare included is a wonderful bonus! I can’t say enough great things about Kameron, the groomers and staff at the Washington location. I have peace of mind knowing my fur babies are always in great care! Thank you to all!

Kim Poirrier :)

I can't recommend The Dog House Pet Salon enough! As a pet owner, finding a trustworthy grooming and boarding service is essential, and I’m so grateful to have found this place. I take my dogs there regularly for grooming, and they always come back looking and feeling amazing. The staff is incredibly professional, and they truly care about the well-being of each animal. A special shout-out to Kameron, who goes above and beyond to make sure every pet is treated with the utmost care and love. Whether it’s for a quick grooming or an extended stay, The Dog House is the only place I trust for my fur babies! Highly recommend!
Compassionate, consistent high quality service! My dog isn’t the easiest, yet they always welcome him with warmth and enthusiasm. Love the grooming and front desk staff!
The dog house is awesome! It’s people like Cameron that make it a great place to leave our puppy in safe hands!
The front desk was rude to Black customer.
Our Rafter loves going here , the staff are all friendly & helpful especially Kam .

I visited The Dog House Pet Salon today for my dogs' grooming, which was overdue by about two months. From the start, the attitude at the front desk was off-putting: the man there came across as arrogant and pompous. When I initially booked the appointment, I mentioned my dogs' history with the salon. They then informed me that one dog needed a Bordetella vaccine, which I agreed to have administered there for $30. However, upon arrival to drop off my dogs, I was asked about vaccinations again. After some confusion, it turned out they didn't have the information I had previously provided. This was frustrating since it was clarified during booking already.

My dogs, a 15-pound Maltipoo and a 28-pound Dachshund-Terrier mix, had minor to medium tangles, nothing severe. Yet, received a call hours later stating they wouldn't groom them because of these tangles, which was surprising given their professional status. I requested just a bath and minor trims around the eyes and rear, which they agreed to do.
Upon picking them up, I was shocked to be charged $80 per dog for essentially just a bath and minor snips. The total came to $200 for services that were far below what was expected from a grooming session which added to my disappointment.

When I brought the dogs home they were so
so so thirsty. As they don't give the dogs water. Which is very interesting. All this rude arrogance and judgment about me and my slightly tangled dogs and caring abilities over a couple mattes, only to have him mistreat and dehydrate my dogs in his care.

This experience was marked by poor customer service, inadequate care for my dogs, extremely high prices with unnecessary upcharges, all delivered with an air of arrogance. I hope this review helps others understand what they might expect at this salon.

I've included photos that were taken same day the dogs were denied.

My golden doodle, Aspen has been going there for almost 2 years for grooming and daycare. She lights up when Courtney and Cameron greet her. Everyone that we come in contact with always compliments her grooming even her vet.
Thank you so much for the 5-star rating! We're thrilled to know that you had a positive experience at The Dog House Pet Salon. We look forward to welcoming you and your furry friend back soon!
Thank you for the 5-star rating! We're thrilled to know you had a positive experience. Looking forward to welcoming you and your furry friend back soon!

Love this place! Courtney is amazing! She’s so sweet and my dog absolutely loves her! She’s very passionate and gentle! We get very excited, when we walk in and see her face!
They do a great job grooming  our big sheepdog. He always looks so handsome after his cuts and baths  !

You can hear the dogs whining outside (the area in the picture) and watched to see but nobody came to check on them. Incredibly disappointing, also it’s 90 degrees out. Hopefully they at least have someone watching.
Thank you so much for the fantastic 5-star rating! We're delighted to know you've had a great experience with us. We look forward to seeing you and your furry friend again soon!

Highly recommend!!! This is our first trip leaving our dog Ace with a boarding facility, but with over 40 years of pets and doing so at different locations all over Houston, this has been the best experience.  Friendly staff, good communication, love the camera access seeing our dog playing with others, and our best groom to date.  The fact that my dog came home exhausted confirms that my dog was not cooped up in a kennel all day but got plenty of play time and exercise.  I love the fact that they do a temperament test to determine the best other dogs to play with during the stay because we all know all dogs are not the same.  In just 6 months we have used 4 other groomers but their groomer has done the best job.  My wife is super picky and loved the way it turned out, even our neighbors asked who we used because it was such a good job.  I will definitely be back for boarding and this will be our groomer for the future.  Highly recommend this place for anyone looking for boarding, daycare, or grooming services.
Thank you for your 5-star rating! We're delighted to hear that you had a great experience with us. We look forward to welcoming you and your furry friend back soon!
Kallie, we appreciate the 5-star love. Thanks a lot!
Puppies first groom went well. Will definitely return

I've been bringing my doodle here for a long time now. I didn't like how they keep the dogs in cages until it is their turn to get groomed without letting them out to potty at all. I've always paid an extra rush fee so that he doesn't have …

The Dog House Salon has been the only place I take my pets for grooming and daycare. The groomers always listen to how I want my pets to look and she has never missed. I love them. We have been going for over a year now.
